## The AI CodeReviewer.

AI agents that review and test pull requests with full context of the codebase.

## How Greptile reviews every PR

Greptile constructs a graph index of your codebase, then uses a swarm of agents to catch potential issues that humans might miss. It builds a graph of your repo, including files, functions, and dependencies. A swarm of parallel agents review changes, assess their impact beyond the diff, and flag issues.

## Catch them all

Greptile identifies issues ranging from style violations to security risks and multi-file logical bugs. Examples include:

*   Unbalanced CUDA release wipes context
*   Undefined method breaks every step()
*   Mid-loop overflow leaves orphaned keys

## Reviews that adapt to your team

From custom rules to continuous learning, Greptile gets smarter about your codebase with every review.

*   **Your house, your rules:** Write standards in plain English, point Greptile at repo-specific context, and enforce the patterns your team actually cares about on every PR.
*   **We're getting to know each other:** Greptile learns your codebase and coding standards by reading your team's PR comments.

## The Central Validation Layer.

Designed to work seamlessly with every coding agent, Greptile serves as the unified validation agent for all code changes.

*   **Fix in your IDE:**
    *   One-click send issue context to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Devin.
    *   Connect Greptile to any AI agent to share comment context.
    *   Let Claude Code automatically read and resolve Greptile comments.
    *   Let any coding agent iterate with Greptile until all issues are resolved.

## Autonomously Test Every PR

Introducing TREX: Greptile Now Runs Your Code. TREX is a Greptile agent that writes and runs tests for every PR in a sandbox to catch bugs and missed edge cases.

## Security-First Design

*   **Enterprise Ready:** Built for enterprises across defense, healthcare, and financial services. Features include SSO, audit logs, and dedicated support.
*   **Self-Hosted Deployment:** Host Greptile in your own air-gapped environment.
*   **SOC 2 Compliance:** Independent audits, reports available on request.

## See what our customers are saying

“We've tried more code review tools than I can count. Greptile outperforms them all by a mile. Honestly the only AI reviewer that doesn't annoy the s**t out of me.”

## FAQ

*   **How does Greptile pricing work?**
    $30/seat/month. 50 credits included per seat. 1 credit = 1 standard review. $1 per additional credit.
*   **Can Greptile be self-hosted?**
    Yes, you can self-host Greptile in your AWS environment and even use your own LLM providers for added flexibility.
*   **Are there free trials or discounts available for Greptile?**
    Greptile offers free usage for qualified open source projects and significant discounts for pre-Series A startups. Contact us to check your eligibility.
*   **What programming languages does Greptile support?**
    Greptile fully supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Elixir, Java, C, C++, C#, Swift, PHP, and Rust. Most other languages are supported with slightly lower response quality.
*   **Is Greptile compatible with GitLab?**
    Yes, Greptile integrates seamlessly with GitLab in addition to GitHub.
*   **Can I use Greptile's API for my own product?**
    Yes, we offer discounted bulk pricing for API use. Please contact us at support@greptile.com for more information.
